node.title: Rank-eleven global-core rank-drop and high-complexity router
node.closure: uniform payment of every descended deviation rank at most nine and fixed-anchor isolation of the full-rank relative high-complexity core
node.statement: In the nonempty line-global common-core branch, exact cancellation preserves the dense pair and deviation dimension r. Every r<=8 residual is paid uniformly by support-local transversality, and r=9 is paid uniformly by the T=667 margin/interleaving split. If r=10, eighteen dense records, a ten-record deviation basis, and three fillers form a fixed residual 31-anchor deck with empty maximal intersection. Every target tuple has degree 18..31 and either yields one relative high-complexity core H_C, or all low-complexity rational certificates cohere after lift into A, with pure-locator, denominator-root, and collision failures routed to E. H_C is not promoted to the deployed first-match spread terminal S.
